data.one_liner: Modular routing and dependency injection system for Flutter using GetIt and GoRouter.
data.what_it_does: Organizes a Flutter application into modules, routes, and dependency injections using GoRouter and GetIt. Supports declarative route syntax, guards, and decoupled event communication across modules.
use_when: You want a modular architecture inspired by Flutter Modular built on top of GoRouter and GetIt
You need route guards that can automatically propagate to submodules
avoid_when: You prefer automatic disposal of module dependencies when leaving a route
You want to use a navigation solution entirely independent of GoRouter
strengths: Clear separation of app code into structured modules
Declarative DSL for routes and clean dependency registration via GetIt
Built-in event system for decoupled cross-module communication
weaknesses: Dependencies are not automatically disposed and live until the application closes
Tied tightly to GoRouter and GetIt paradigms
data.setup_notes: Configure the root module with Modugo.configure and supply modugoRouter to MaterialApp.router.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using GoRouter directly without Modugo's modular wrapper layer.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer code-generation-based routing instead of Modugo's runtime modular approach.
